Hisingen / native macOS menu-bar app

Polestar and Volvo, from your Mac.

Check battery, range, charging and vehicle health from the menu bar. Hisingen connects directly to supported provider services and tells you when data is stale or unavailable.

The useful part

Read the state.
Then decide what to do.

Hisingen puts the information you normally look up on your phone into a small, native Mac utility. It does not pretend an estimate is a fact, or hide when a provider has not reported something.

02 / INSPECT

More than a battery gauge.

Powertrain, range-health estimate, service, warranty and vehicle identity live beside the overview. The range-health figure is model-based, not a measured battery-capacity test.

  • Battery and range estimates
  • Service schedule and warnings
  • Vehicle-reported health details
  • Trip and charging history

03 / FOLLOW

Know what is happening.

Charging, openings, tyres and climate are presented as reported by the vehicle, with unavailable and vehicle-dependent states left visible.

See supported vehicles →

04 / CONTROL

Actions stay explicit.

Standard builds do not send remote commands. Experimental command support, where present, is opt-in, excluded from distributed builds and not guaranteed to execute.

See capability notes →

What Hisingen can show

A deeper view of your vehicle.

The menu-bar overview is the entry point. Open it when you need more: energy, diagnostics, maintenance, location, software and provider-specific detail.

05 / ENERGY

Charging, fuel and range.

Follow charging state, connection type, power, current, voltage, target and estimated completion when the vehicle reports them. Combustion and hybrid vehicles expose fuel readings where available.

Charging sessions are local summaries built from consecutive vehicle polls and can be exported as CSV or JSON.

06 / HEALTH

Diagnostics that explain a warning.

Service timing, fluid warnings, brake status, 12V battery information, software and vehicle-reported health are grouped by provider capability.

Unavailable data stays unavailable instead of becoming a guess.

07 / CONTEXT

Location and weather are optional.

Vehicle location, reverse-geocoded address and weather context can be enabled separately. Coordinates are sent to Apple or Open-Meteo only when those features are enabled.

Disable location or weather when you do not want those third-party requests.

08 / MACOS

More than a window.

Use system appearance, configurable units, notifications, deep links, App Intents and Shortcuts around the menu-bar utility. Multiple vehicles keep their own state and charging history.

Hisingen is a native AppKit and SwiftUI application for macOS 14 and later.

Two providers / one Hisingen

Same calm interface.
Different connections.

Hisingen keeps Polestar and Volvo credentials, APIs and capability rules separate. Your car decides what is available.

Polestar

Independent integration based on current first-party client behavior. Optional capabilities can change without notice.

Polestar support →

Volvo

Official Connected Vehicle and Energy APIs. Volvo requires your own developer application credentials.

Support, without guesswork

Does Hisingen support your car?

These are integration profiles, not promises that every feature is available. Hisingen checks capabilities per vehicle and keeps uncertainty visible.

Supported vehicle providers, represented models and capability notes
ProviderModels representedWhat to expect
Polestar1, 2, 3, 4, 5Polestar 2 has the broadest live verification. Other models use conservative profiles and runtime probing.
VolvoXC40, EX40, C40, EC40, XC60, XC90, S60, S90, V60, V90, EX30, EX90, ES90Official API integration. Energy capabilities are detected at runtime; tyre data is qualitative.

Standard distributed builds do not send remote commands. Experimental paths depend on provider, vehicle, account, region and live capability detection.

Trust is part of the product

Your credentials stay on your Mac.

Authentication and vehicle requests go directly from Hisingen to Polestar or Volvo services. Sessions are stored locally in macOS Keychain using device-only protection.

Read the security policy ↗
Keychain
Separate provider sessions. No iCloud Keychain sync.
Local cache
Vehicle snapshots are cached locally; sensitive fields are deliberately omitted from persisted copies.
No analytics
No advertising, tracking, developer telemetry or Hisingen account.
Inspectable
Open-source code and a documented data path on GitHub.

Questions before download

The short version.

Is Hisingen official Polestar or Volvo software?+

No. Hisingen is independent open-source software and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by Polestar Performance AB or Volvo Car Corporation.

Why are some features unavailable?+

Capabilities vary by model, model year, region, account role, vehicle state and backend rollout. Standard distributed builds are read-only.

Does Hisingen track users?+

No. There is no analytics, advertising, developer-operated backend or usage telemetry. Optional location, weather and update-check requests are described in the project terms.

Where are credentials stored?+

Polestar and Volvo sessions are stored locally in separate macOS Keychain entries. They use device-only protection and do not sync to iCloud Keychain.
